rewrites.//: Google sign-in on a phone goes out to Google and comes back, and Firebase parks the state for that round trip on closet-bg.firebaseapp.com. Safari and Firefox treat storage on a domain that isn't the one you're looking at as third-party and bin it, so the browser returns from Google having forgotten why it left. Proxying Firebase's auth handler through our own domain makes that storage first-party and the round trip survives. Set authDomain to this site's own host for it to take effect.
